sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: Peganum harmala, Syrian rue, is a glabrous perennial 30–70 cm tall, branching near the base. It grows in dry regions of North Africa and western Asia.

sections.title: Leaves, flowers and fruit
sections.text: The alternate leaves are divided into three to five linear lobes. The white to yellowish flowers are solitary. The globose capsule has three chambers and contains dark, triangular seeds.

sections.title: Toxicity
sections.text: The seeds and fruits contain toxic alkaloids; poisoning of cattle, sheep and probably horses is documented. Do not eat the seeds or other parts of the plant.
